subject: How to remove vertical spaces from div environment

messages.author: 3e61d70b14b90239
messages.subject: How to remove vertical spaces from div environment
parts:
Hello everyone,

I'm developing my own shiny apps for a while but not really experienced on HTML coding. I want to remove vertical spaces which comes up with column(...) function within fluidRow(...). I have 2x2 layout for graph output and i will let users edit each graph seperately. I have defined 4 different plotOutput(...) but it comes to output with vertical space as i mentioned before. I have found that "line-height" is used to remove this unwanted space but it does not work for me where it is used as below. Here is a part of my code:

....
mainPanel(
 tags$head(
   tags$style(type='text/css', ".span8 { line-height: 0px; }")
 ),

  tabsetPanel(
    tabPanel(title="graph",
       fluidRow(
          column(5, plotOutput("plot11")),
          column(1),
          column(5, plotOutput("plot12"))
       ),
       ## Vertical Space occurs between above and below rows (here)
       fluidRow(
          column(5, plotOutput("plot21")),
          column(1),
          column(5, plotOutput("plot22"))
       )
    )
  )
)

Thanks in advance,

dincer.
